name: skills-marketplace
description: Private marketplace for the conductor/subagent orchestration pattern and its domain skills (Bevy, Rust, TypeScript, Vue3, Blender).

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Conductor orchestrator + 5 subagents (planning, research, implement, code-review, memory) with their preloaded skills and MCP servers.

plugins.name: bevy
plugins.description: Bevy 0.18.1 ECS conventions, plugin architecture, and gameplay patterns. Apply when writing or reviewing Bevy game code.

plugins.name: blender
plugins.description: Blender-to-Bevy workflow conventions using bevy_skein 0.5. Apply when writing code that integrates with Blender or uses bevy_skein.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust coding standards and conventions. Apply when writing or reviewing Rust files.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript coding standards. Apply when writing or reviewing TypeScript or TSX files.

plugins.name: vue3
plugins.description: Vue 3 coding standards with Composition API, Pinia, and TypeScript. Apply when writing or reviewing .vue files and Vue-related composables.

plugins.name: sequential-thinking-skill
plugins.description: Structured, branching, revisable sequential-thinking reasoning via a local Node script — MCP-parity, no MCP server required.
